working_definition: TmY5a is a narrow-field transmedullary Y neuron of the adult Drosophila optic lobe. Its cell body lies in the distal cortex of the medulla and it extends a Y-shaped arbor via the second optic chiasm into the lobula (layers 4, 5 and 6) and lobula plate (layers 1 and 3), with additional arborizations across medulla layers M2-M9. It is glutamatergic.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary Y narrow field neuron that terminates with both fine and bleb-type arborizations in lobula layers 4, 5 and 6, and in lobula plate layer 3, but only has fine arborizations in lobula plate layer 1. It displays both fine and bleb-type arborizations in medulla layers M6 and M8, and has fine arborizations in medulla layers M2, M3, M4, M5 and M9 (Morante and Desplan, 2008; Fischbach and Dittrich (1989). It is glutamatergic (Davis et al., 2020).

justification: FBbt:00003823 carries the label 'transmedullary Y neuron TmY5a', which corresponds directly to the cluster label 'TmY5a'. The FBbt definition specifies the same narrow-field TmY morphology, the identical layer-by-layer arborization pattern in the medulla, lobula and lobula plate, and glutamatergic neurotransmitter identity — all consistent with the working definition derived from established optic-lobe anatomy. The term is not obsolete. No ambiguity or subtype uncertainty is present; this is the canonical adult anatomical term for this cell type.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the transmedullary Y neuron TmY5a (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Erm/Ey temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: This term represents the immature (developing/pupal) form of TmY5a, not the adult neuron. The Kurmangaliyev 2020 atlas contains adult and late-pupal cells; the cluster label 'TmY5a' maps to the adult cell type. The immature term is a sibling, not the appropriate match for an adult-identity cluster.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: An intrinsic columnar neuron of the optic lobe whose cell body lies in the distal cortex of the medulla and that arborizes in the medulla and branches in the second optic chiasm with one branch innervating the lobula and the other the lobula plate.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent class of TmY5a; too broad. The specific subtype term FBbt:00003823 is available and preferred.

recommendation: Accept exact match to FBbt:00003823 (transmedullary Y neuron TmY5a). The label, layer-level morphological description and glutamatergic identity are all consistent. No new term needed.
